h1: The 5 Best TV Stands with Mount of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best TV Stands with Mount: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: five TV stands with a built-in mount bracket, compared on TV size, VESA support, weight limits and storage so the fit is right.
summary: The FITUEYES 32 to 70 inch stand is the best overall with a 110 lb mount, 25 degree swivel each way and the widest VESA range. The MJOMKN adds a power strip and drawers. The Mount-It! MI-864 is the value pick for TVs up to 60 inches. The FITUEYES wood model suits 55 inch sets, and the corner stand handles small rooms.
intro: The bracket is the part buyers check last and regret first. A stand with a built-in mount looks like a bargain until you learn your TV's VESA pattern falls outside the bracket's range, or the TV outweighs the mount rating. At that point the stand is an expensive shelf, and the real fix is a different stand or a wall mount you did not budget for.

We ranked five stands with included mounts on the Primea framework, using spec sheets for TV size, VESA range, load limits, swivel and storage. Every pick below names its numbers, so you can lay your own TV's size, hole pattern and weight against the stand before you order. Look up your TV's manual first.

products.name: FITUEYES TV Stand with Mount for 32-70 inch TVs, Swivel Floor Entertainment Center
products.verdict: The widest TV range, with swivel and shelf capacity.
products.description:
The FITUEYES 32 to 70 inch floor stand is the one whose numbers leave you room. Its mount holds up to 110 lbs, covers VESA patterns from 200x200 to 600x400 and swivels 25 degrees each way, with two height levels. The shelf ratings of 33 and 55 lbs are stated too, which is rare in this category.

It ranks first because it fits the widest set of TVs. The MJOMKN matches the 32 to 70 inch range but gives no weight limit, so you cannot check the margin. The Mount-It! covers only 32 to 60 inches and 88 lbs. At $100 to $200 it costs more than the Mount-It!.

Buy it for a large TV that might be replaced by a bigger one. The caveat is the minimum VESA of 200x200: a small TV with a 100x100 pattern will not fit.

products.name: MJOMKN TV Stand with Mount and Power Outlet, Swivel LED Lights for 32-70 Inch TVs
products.verdict: Power strip, drawers and a wide swivel in one unit.
products.description:
The MJOMKN is built around convenience. It fits 32 to 70 inch TVs, swivels 34 degrees each way, offers three height positions and includes a power strip with 4 AC outlets and 2 USB ports. Three drawers plus shelves hold consoles and remotes, and anti-tip straps come in the box.

It ranks second because the listing does not state the mount weight rating or the VESA range, and those two numbers decide whether your TV can be mounted at all. The FITUEYES 32 to 70 lists both. A bigger swivel arc and drawers are real gains, but they do not replace a load figure.

Choose it if you want a tidy cable setup, with outlets built in, and have a TV mid-range in size. The caveat is the missing specs. Check the product page for VESA and weight before you trust it with a large set.
products.skipIf: You need a stated weight limit.

products.name: Mount-It! TV Stand with Mount and Storage Shelves MI-864, Fits 32-60 Inch Screens
products.verdict: Glass shelves and a wide VESA range for $50-100.
products.description:
The Mount-It! MI-864 is the value choice for smaller screens. It fits 32 to 60 inch TVs, covers VESA patterns from 75x75 to 600x400 and holds up to 88 lbs. Three tempered glass shelves, an aluminum powder-coated frame and a built-in cable channel handle storage and tidy cabling.

It ranks third because the 88 lb rating is lower than the FITUEYES 32 to 70's 110 lbs, and the maximum screen is 60 inches, ten inches below the leader. Its edge is VESA range: 75x75 starts lower, so small older TVs with tiny hole patterns can fit. It costs $50 to $100.

Buy it for a 43 to 55 inch TV in a bedroom or living room. The caveat is the glass: tempered shelves are sturdy but heavy, so lift with a helper.

products.name: FITUEYES Wood TV Stand with Mount for 32-55 inch TVs, 2 Tier Entertainment Center
products.verdict: A warmer wood look for smaller TVs.
products.description:
The FITUEYES wood stand is the one that looks like furniture. It fits 32 to 55 inch TVs, covers VESA patterns from 100x100 to 400x400, holds up to 77 lbs and gives three height levels. Two removable wood shelves and a golden walnut finish suit a living room more than the metal frames above.

It ranks fourth because the numbers are tighter. The 77 lb limit is well below the 110 lbs on the larger FITUEYES, and 400x400 is the top VESA pattern, so many 55 inch sets will just fit and some will not. The Mount-It! allows 88 lbs and a 600x400 pattern for less money.

Choose it for a mid-size TV in a room where appearance matters. The caveat is headroom: check your TV's weight and VESA closely, because this stand has less spare capacity than the metal models.
products.skipIf: You own a 60 inch or larger TV.

products.name: Universal Floor Small Corner TV Stand with Mount, 23-50 inch TVs
products.verdict: A corner-friendly rack for small TVs.
products.description:
The Universal Floor Small Corner stand is the specialist. It fits 23 to 50 inch TVs, holds 80 lbs on the TV rack and puts 40 lbs on each of its three open mesh shelves. The bracket adjusts from 3.5 to 18.9 inches wide, and adjustable rubber feet level it on uneven floors.

It ranks last because the spec set is the narrowest. There is no swivel or height range to match the others, and the corner design limits where you can put it. Its advantage is size: it fits the smaller TVs in a tight room, a range of 23 to 50 inches that the others do not cover.

Buy it for a bedroom or dorm with a small screen. The caveat is capacity: the shelves carry only 40 lbs each, so skip heavy consoles.

whatMatters.detail: VESA is the hole pattern on the back of your TV, measured in millimeters. The bracket must cover it or the TV will not bolt on. Find the pattern in your TV's manual and compare it with the range in the title or bullets. The FITUEYES 32 to 70 starts at 200x200, while the Mount-It! begins at 75x75.

The mount has a load limit separate from the shelves. A 110 lb mount, as on the FITUEYES 32 to 70, gives headroom for a large TV, while a 77 lb one on the wood FITUEYES is tighter. Look for a stated lbs figure, compare it with your TV's weight in the manual, and leave a margin.

A stand rated for 32 to 70 inches is not the same as one rated for 23 to 50. Check the maximum size and leave margin if you may upgrade later. The MJOMKN and FITUEYES 32 to 70 reach 70 inches, the Mount-It! stops at 60, and the corner stand stops at 50. Match the range to your TV and your next one.

Swivel lets you angle the screen toward a sofa, and height levels match your seating. A 25 or 34 degree swivel is useful in open rooms and L-shaped living spaces. The FITUEYES lists 25 degrees each way and the MJOMKN 34. Read the bullet points for swivel and height settings before ordering.

A tall mount makes a stand top-heavy, especially with a large TV on top. Anti-tip hardware and wide bases help. Check whether straps are included, as with the MJOMKN, and look at base width in the photos. Households with children or pets should treat anti-tip hardware as a requirement, not an extra.

faq.q: Will any TV fit a built-in mount?
faq.a: No. Check the VESA pattern and weight against the stand. The Mount-It! MI-864 covers 75x75 to 600x400, while the FITUEYES 32 to 70 starts at 200x200, so small patterns can fail.

faq.q: What if my TV is heavier than the mount rating?
faq.a: Do not use the stand, because an overloaded bracket can fail or lean. Choose one with a higher rating, such as the 110 lb FITUEYES 32 to 70, and confirm the weight in your TV's manual first.

faq.q: Is the MJOMKN worth it over the FITUEYES?
faq.a: If you need built-in power and drawers, yes: the MJOMKN has 4 AC outlets and 2 USB ports. If a stated weight limit and VESA range matter more, the FITUEYES is safer.

faq.q: How do I set up a floor stand?
faq.a: Assemble on a flat floor, attach the bracket to the TV first, then lift both onto the stand with a helper. Level the base before loading the shelves, and tighten every bolt once the TV is seated.

faq.q: Should I use the anti-tip hardware?
faq.a: Yes. It matters most in homes with kids or pets, and the MJOMKN includes straps. Use them even if the stand feels stable, since a heavy TV can tip when pushed.

faq.q: Can I put a soundbar on these?
faq.a: Often yes, on the shelves, but a soundbar adds weight. Check the shelf ratings, like 33 or 55 lbs on the FITUEYES 32 to 70 or 40 lbs per mesh shelf on the corner stand, before loading heavy gear.

finalTake: Buy the FITUEYES 32 to 70 inch stand when you want the safest weight margin and the widest TV range. Take the MJOMKN if built-in outlets and drawers matter. The Mount-It! fits sets up to 60 inches for less. Pick the corner stand only for a small TV and a tight room. Match VESA, weight and size to your TV before you order.
